chapter: Arriving in New York and founding the Afro-Cubans
title: Original personnel of the Afro-Cubans
summary: Trumpets Doc Cheatham and Mario, saxes Johnny Nieto, Freddy Skerritt and Pin Madera, with Tony Escollies, Bilingue, Julio Andino and Frank Ayala.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Okay. When you and Mario got together, who were your trumpet players then?
That was Doc Cheatham and Mario and the saxophone was Johnny Nieto, Freddy Skerrittand Pin Madera.
Okay, later on came Bobby Woodlen, right?
Bobby Woodlen substitute ehh - what you call him - Doc Cheatham, because Doc Cheatham went to Teddy Wilson.
I see. Okay, who was your timbal player or did you have one at that time?
Yes I - Tony Escollies, El Cojito.
Okay, and your bongosero at that time?
Julio Andino, and that was your group then, right?
